items.why: The report fits the doublet with two components, "2LA(M) at 351.1, E2g1 at 355.3", and warns that "The doublet must be fit with two components".
It gives "Height 2LA(M)/A1g = 1802/806 = 2.24 at spot 1; 527/1133 = 0.46 at spot 2" and calls the spot 1 ratio a monolayer signature.
It reports "A1g +2.80 cm-1 (417.28 to 420.08)" and reads spot 1 as 1L and spot 2 as bulk-like.
It gives Delta = 61.99 and 64.70 cm-1 after the two-component fit, and notes that the single-Lorentzian fit gives a misleading "65.6/66.9 cm-1".

It says the separation "saturates at 64.6-64.8 cm-1 for 3L-to-bulk", lists the A1g series 417.2/418.4/419.0/420.1, and notes the 1L-2L gap is only 1.4 cm-1, so thickness beyond the monolayer is weakly constrained.
It checks Si calibration ("Si calibration offset is +0.21 cm-1 at spot 1"), says the 514.5 nm spectrum is resonant, and says the 2LA/A1g ratio depends on the "exact laser line".

wrong_claims.why: The report explicitly rejects the single-band reading: "would wrongly suggest thick material at both spots" and "do not use it".
It assigns the band as the second-order 2LA(M) overtone and says LA(M) "is not a defect marker in WS2".
